headline: Stew's Hospital Ward Acquires Another Injured Running Back
publicationDraft: With McCaffrey and Barkley sidelined, Stew traded Cooper for Gibson, who was already playing through a publicly disclosed shin stress fracture. Thommy had enough backfield depth to add a receiver. Gibson aggravated the injury in his first game for Stew but recovered enough to contribute when McCaffrey went down again. Cooper missed two games with COVID and never delivered a decisive December performance in a paired matchup. In their Week 10 showdown, Thommy won by 30.54 despite Cooper scoring only 7.10; Gibson's 20.80 sat on Stew's bench. Starting Gibson instead of any nonnegative-scoring eligible starter could not have erased that deficit by itself. Both strategies made sense, but Stew bought another medical risk out of necessity. Gibson's later contribution made the gamble defensible.
